description: This source file 'handle_get.c' handles the processing of USP 'Get' requests, including parsing incoming messages, resolving data model paths, building response messages, managing internal data structures for requested paths and parameters, and optionally performing direct gets through a broker interface. It contains functions for expanding and resolving path expressions, forming responses, and adding results to the response message.
external_methods: Error handling and utility functions from other included headers

methods.name: void MSG_HANDLER_HandleGet(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Main handler for incoming USP Get messages, it validates the message, creates a response, processes each path expression possibly via direct broker interaction, resolves paths, and constructs the corresponding response.

methods.name: void ExpandGetPathExpression(int get_expr_index,char * path_expr,int depth,get_expr_info_t * gi,group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Expands a path expression into individual parameters, resolving the path, and filling in group get vectors for further processing.

methods.name: void FormPathExprResponse(int get_expr_index,char * path_expr,get_expr_info_t * gi,group_get_vector_t * ggv,kv_vector_t * kvv,Usp__Msg * resp)
methods.description: Forms the response for a specific path expression, including successful parameter retrievals and error statuses.

methods.name: void AddResolvedPathResult(Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * req_path_result,char * path,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a parameter and its value to the response, creating object path groupings as needed.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult * FindResolvedPath(Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * req_path_result,char * obj_path)
methods.description: Searches for a resolved object in the response message by object path to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateGetResp(char * msg_id)
methods.description: Creates an empty GetResponse message with the specified message ID.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * AddGetResp_ReqPathRes(Usp__Msg * resp,char * requested_path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a requested path result to the response, initialized with error code and message.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult * AddReqPathRes_ResolvedPathResult(Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * req_path_result,char * obj_path)
methods.description: Adds a resolved object path entry to a requested path result.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult__ResultParamsEntry * AddResolvedPathRes_ParamsEntry(Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult * resolved_path_res,char * param_name,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a parameter key-value pair to a resolved path result.

methods.name: void HandleDirectGet(int num_path_expr,char ** path_exprs,int depth,get_expr_info_t * get_expr_info,group_get_vector_t * ggv,Usp__Msg * resp)
methods.description: Performs an optimized top-level get through a broker interface for registered USP services, handling unresolved parameters separately.
